hints: The arrow turns a little each time. Check which way it turns and by how much.
From → to ↗ is an eighth of a turn (45°) against the way a clock's hands move (counterclockwise).
Each step is an eighth of a turn counterclockwise: right, up-right, up, up-left. Turn ↖ one more eighth of a turn the same way.

solution.methodName: Check one change at a time

steps.action: Check how the arrow turns: → to ↗ to ↑ to ↖.
Each step is an eighth of a turn (45°) counterclockwise, the opposite way to a clock's hands.
steps.why: Going around counterclockwise in eighths: →, ↗, ↑, ↖, ←, ↙, ↓, ↘. The series moves along this list one arrow at a time.

steps.action: Turn ↖ one more eighth of a turn counterclockwise. It now points straight left.

trapNotes.↙: ↙ is two eighths (a quarter turn) from ↖. Each step in this series is only one eighth of a turn (45°).
trapNotes.↑: ↑ turns back the way it came (clockwise). The arrow keeps turning counterclockwise: →, ↗, ↑, ↖, then ←.
trapNotes.↘: ↘ points the opposite way to ↖, which is a half turn. Each step is only an eighth of a turn.
